import json
from copy import deepcopy
from work import evaluate

p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'x>y':{'role':'admin'},'f>r':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
cases=[
 ({'from':'z','to':'q'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'x','to':'y','role':'wrong','attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':False}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'r','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'r','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for request, expected in cases:
 rb=deepcopy(request); pb=deepcopy(p); actual=evaluate(request,p)
 assert actual==expected,(request,actual,expected)
 assert request==rb and p==pb
 assert set(actual)=={'ok','value','reason'}
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('11 boundary cases, immutability, exact fields, and report passed')
